title: PDCF Node Capability Descriptor
description: Standard schema for PDCF nodes advertising available capabilities across the coordination layer.

node_id.description: Unique uniform resource name (URN) identifying the node.

attestation_tier.description: Cryptographic attestation level of the host node.

safety_level.description: PDCF Risk Tier (0: Informational, 1: Reversible Digital, 2: Persistent Digital, 3: Physical-World, 4: High-Consequence).

parameters.description: JSON Schema object defining valid input arguments for this capability.

required_policy.description: Identifier of the baseline policy governing invocation.
